data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate opened 2020 with gross claims outstanding of USD 727.385m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development (gross) of approximately USD 54.0m (about 7.4% of opening gross reserves) for underwriting years 2014-2018, i.e. a net strengthening of reserves. The 2020 underwriting result was materially affected by COVID-19 business interruption losses (principally in property) and elevated natural catastrophe activity (notably the North Atlantic hurricane season). The financial statements and notes also disclose reinsurance transfers and reinsurance-to-close activity during the year which can distort reserve movements and the development tables.
raw_causal_phrases: losses arising from the COVID-19 pandemic, principally losses arising from business interruption in our property portfolio, and an elevated level of losses resulting from natural catastrophes, principally from the North Atlantic hurricane season.

Included within net outstanding claims of USD 774.1m (2019: USD 438.1m) is a decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2019 and prior years of account of USD 145.2m (2019: decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2018 and prior years of account USD 77.0m).

Following the closure of Syndicate 2007 and Syndicate 6129 effective 31 December 2020, the assets and liabilities of Syndicate 2007 transferred into Syndicate 1686 as part of a planned reinsurance to close transaction.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle. The report also contains net statements about releases (e.g. a net decrease of USD 145.2m relating to 2019 and prior years) which include reinsurance effects and/or movements in 2019; the triangle-based gross PYD (USD +54.0m) excludes the two most recent years and therefore differs from the net narrative. The claims triangle and movements may be distorted by the reinsurance-to-close (RITC) transfer of Syndicate 2007 and Syndicate 6129 into Syndicate 1686 effective 31 December 2020; this RITC is noted in the report and may affect comparability.
